title: The average Anthropic employee is now worth $ 44 million

author: Varun Mayya
description:
In this Kata, we talk about copying and why innovation often starts
with learning from what already works. We look at examples from
companies like Apple, Tesla, and BYD, and how studying existing
products, breaking them down, and understanding how they work can help
you build something of your own.

We discuss how constraints can lead to original ideas, using examples
from Unleash the Avatar and content creation, and why understanding
what works matters more than copying it blindly.

We then look at creating versus capturing value, and how cash flow at
AEOS funds new experiments. The goal is to learn from what exists, add
something of your own, and build towards innovation.
